blocks.text: Initial render shows: misaligned cards (card 2 taller, card 3 dropped); table has no Session width (unicode character) so titles/names clip with no ellipsis; footer pushed below 720px; registration summary rows/note overly spaced. Fixing layout styles first.

Now all text fits without clipping and footer is visible; cards aligned, all 8 sessions wrap cleanly. Remaining issues: registration column has large empty space at bottom (misaligned with schedule) and table has extra blank space under last row. Balancing that space next.

Registration now stretches to match the schedule, but `space-between` spread the rows unevenly, creating uneven gaps between summary rows—inconsistent spacing. Restricting distribution to the note block only.
`margin-top:auto` on the section pushed the whole registration panel down (top misaligned at y≈340 vs y≈184). Removing it while keeping the note at bottom.

Registration tops/bottoms now align and summary rows are evenly spaced; the only leftover is a blank gap above the desk-hours note. Filling it with more comfortable, even row spacing and using fewer oversized flex rules.

Rows are comfortably spaced now, but a ~90px void remains between the OPEN pill and the hours note. Reducing the registration card height by shrinking schedule row padding, so the panels end closer under their content.
Table header now sits tight against the first row, and the bottom void is only ~40px—balanced. One minor consistency fix: make the pill line-height match the note before final check.
